title: Characterising divergence between heuristic and language-model ratings of mobile user interface quality
abstract: arXiv:2609.05423v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automated assessment of mobile user interface quality is attractive because manual review does not scale, and large language models are increasingly proposed for the task. Whether their ratings correspond to those produced by established rule-based heuristics has not been characterised at scale. We construct a 15,000-screen corpus from the RICO dataset using six documented filters, score every screen with a literature-grounded heuristic scorer, and collect ratings from three open-weight language models across two input representations, yielding 270,000 ratings. We report linearly weighted Cohen's kappa with bootstrap confidence intervals, offset-corrected kappa, intraclass correlation, and Bland-Altman limits of agreement, together with a chance baseline for the tolerance-band agreement rule. Agreement between the two rating sources is consistently weak: raw kappa falls below 0.15 in seventeen of eighteen model-representation-d

translated_title: 刻画启发式方法与大语言模型对移动用户界面质量评分之间的分歧
translated_abstract: 移动用户界面质量的自动化评估颇具吸引力，因为人工审查无法规模化，而大语言模型正日益被提议用于该任务。然而，大语言模型的评分是否与成熟的基于规则的启发式方法所得评分相符，此前尚未得到大规模的刻画。我们使用六项已记录的筛选规则从RICO数据集中构建了一个包含15,000个屏幕的语料库，用基于文献的启发式评分器对每个屏幕进行评分，并从三个开源权重的大语言模型在两种输入表示下收集评分，共获得270,000个评分。我们报告了带自助法置信区间的线性加权Cohen's kappa、偏移校正kappa、组内相关系数以及Bland-Altman一致性界限，并同时给出针对容差带一致性规则的机会基线。结果显示，两种评分来源之间的一致性始终较弱：在十八个模型-表示-领域组合中的十七个里，原始kappa低于0.15（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究首次在大规模上比较了大语言模型与基于规则的启发式方法对移动用户界面质量的评分，通过270,000个评分发现两类评分来源之间的一致性持续偏弱（kappa普遍低于0.15），揭示了大语言模型评分与既有启发式标准之间存在系统性分歧。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first large-scale characterisation of divergence between language-model and rule-based heuristic ratings of mobile UI quality, showing through 270,000 ratings that agreement between the two sources is consistently weak (kappa below 0.15 in seventeen of eighteen configurations).
